# PursuitDesk Backend

pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test:contracts
pnpm test:route-envelopes
pnpm test:auth-tenant
pnpm ci:release-gate

## Linked issue

- Closes:

## Proof

- [ ] pnpm lint

- [ ] pnpm test:contracts

- [ ] pnpm test:auth-tenant
- [ ] pnpm ci:release-gate

## Release notes

- Rollback plan:
- Affected rooms:

name: Primary PR gate

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  primary-pr-gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: corepack enable
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm test:contracts
